steps_basic.title: Choose pet
steps_basic.instruction: Choose a Pet sprite or rename cat to Pet.

steps_basic.title: Pet talks
steps_basic.instruction: Say 'Hello! I am your pet!' for 2 seconds.
steps_basic.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
say [Hello! I am your pet!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Happy start
steps_standard.instruction: Green flag: set mood to happy, switch to happy costume.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]

steps_standard.title: Get hungry
steps_standard.instruction: Forever: wait 10s, set mood hungry, switch costume, say hungry.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]
forever
  wait (10) seconds
  set [mood v] to [hungry]
  switch costume to [hungry v]
  say [I'm hungry!] for (2) seconds

steps_standard.title: Food button
steps_standard.instruction: Add Food sprite. When clicked, broadcast FEED.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [FEED v]

steps_standard.title: Pet eats
steps_standard.instruction: Pet: when receive FEED, set mood happy, switch costume, say Yum.
steps_standard.blocks_text:
when I receive [FEED v]
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]
say [Yum!] for (1) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Energy variable
steps_advanced.instruction: Make 'energy' variable. Set to 10 on green flag.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [energy v] to (10)

steps_advanced.title: Energy drains
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when green flag clicked
set [energy v] to (10)
forever
  wait (5) seconds
  change [energy v] by (-1)

steps_advanced.title: Get sleepy
steps_advanced.instruction: If energy < 3, set mood sleepy, switch costume, say sleepy.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
if <(energy) < (3)> then
  set [mood v] to [sleepy]
  switch costume to [sleepy v]
  say [So sleepy...] for (2) seconds

steps_advanced.title: Sleep button
steps_advanced.instruction: Add Sleep sprite. When clicked, broadcast SLEEP.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when this sprite clicked
broadcast [SLEEP v]

steps_advanced.title: Pet sleeps
steps_advanced.instruction: Pet: when receive SLEEP, set energy 10, mood happy, costume happy.
steps_advanced.blocks_text:
when I receive [SLEEP v]
set [energy v] to (10)
set [mood v] to [happy]
switch costume to [happy v]
